Since \(f(x)=2\sin(x+\theta)\) with \(\theta=\phi+\frac{\pi}{3}\), oddness gives
\[
\sin(-x+\theta)=-\sin(x+\theta)
\]
so
\[
\sin(\theta-x)+\sin(\theta+x)=2\sin\theta\cos x=0.
\]
Thus \(\sin\theta=0\). Since \(\theta\in[\frac{\pi}{3},\frac{4\pi}{3}]\), \(\theta=\pi\), so \(\phi=\frac{2\pi}{3}\).

Then
\[
f\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}+\pi\right)
=2\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}=-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
